SIGNS OF A TOO-HARSH CLEANSER
The 'tight, squeaky, dry' feeling after washing - once mistaken for 'clean' - is actually a sign the skin barrier has been eroded. This prompts skin to produce more compensating oil, causing an oil-acne vicious cycle. Gentle surfactants solve this problem at the root.

CHOOSING SURFACTANTS BY SKIN TYPE
Oily, acne-prone skin suits amino acid systems that control sebum gently; dry, sensitive skin suits ultra-gentle sugar bases (glucosides); normal skin can use balanced blended formulas. Xu hướng bao bì tái chế PCR và vật liệu: The Trend of PCR Recycled Packaging and Green Materials in the Cosmetics Industry
Doanh nghiệp mỹ phẩm chuyển dịch sang sử: Cosmetics businesses are shifting to post-consumer recycled PCR plastic and biodegradable bagasse-paper boxes for sustainable development.
Sử dụng bao bì sinh thái không còn là sự:
Using eco-friendly packaging is no longer a choice but has become a social responsibility and a demanding competitive standard. PCR (Post-Consumer Recycled) plastic recycles old plastic waste into elegant premium cosmetic bottles, sharply reducing virgin plastic and waste into the environment. In parallel, boxes made of bagasse paper, FSC recycled paper or biodegradable materials are winning over Gen Z users, driving a strong global green transition.

GREEN MATERIAL SOLUTIONS
Besides PCR plastic, the market favours: bioplastics (bio-PE from sugarcane), glass (infinitely recyclable), lightweight aluminium, refill designs that cut waste, and plant-based inks. Each option has its own pros and cons in cost, aesthetics and compatibility with the formula and must be weighed carefully against product positioning.

GENUINELY GREEN - NOT 'GREENWASHING'
Consumers are increasingly sharp and boycott 'greenwashing' brands - claiming sustainability without substance. Transparency about recycled content and material certification is a must. Cosbuilt advises on suitable green packaging supply chains, helping brands be both beautiful and sustainable in an authentic, trustworthy way.
